name: Piburger See
kurzbeschreibung: Piburger See above Oetz is Tirol's warmest mountain bathing lake, set in an idyllic protected nature reserve framed by dense coniferous forest.
preis: Free access to lake and shoreline trails (swimming lido charges entrance fee)
oeffnungszeiten: Accessible year-round; swimming facilities and boat rentals open May to September
beschreibung:
Überblick

Lake Piburger See, situated at an altitude of 913 metres above the historic village of Oetz at the threshold of the Ötztal, ranks among Tirol's oldest and most treasured nature conservation reserves. Created by a colossal prehistoric rock avalanche that dammed the mountain basin, this crystal-clear body of water covers roughly fourteen hectares with depths descending to twenty-five metres. A remarkable geographic circumstance accounts for its fame: sheltered from alpine winds within a forested depression and bathed in abundant sunlight, surface water temperatures climb to twenty-four degrees Celsius during midsummer, establishing Piburger See as one of the warmest natural bathing lakes in the Austrian Alps. Emerald waters mirror fragrant spruce groves, while the jagged pyramid of the Acherkogel towers prominently above.

Route & Anforderungen

Visiting Lake Piburger See offers delightful experiences for casual walkers, families, and avid hikers. The classic shoreline circuit meanders along shaded forest tracks encircling the lake in roughly one hour (distance approx. 3.5 km, minimal elevation change, easy grade T1). Timber boardwalks, scenic viewing spurs, and sunbathing decks invite swimmers to relax. For a longer hike, begin in Oetz and ascend via the scenic Wellerbrücke bridge over the rushing Ötztaler Ache river, climbing the steep Piburger Steig trail to the hamlet of Piburg (approx. 45 minutes, requiring sure footing). Standard trainers suffice for the lake loop, whereas sturdy hiking shoes are recommended for the ravine trail.

Besuch & Anreise

Access by car proceeds via motorway A12 (exit Ötztal) and federal highway B186 south into Oetz. From the village center, a paved mountain road winds uphill to designated parking areas in the hamlet of Piburg. Arriving by public transit is straightforward with regional trains serving Ötztal Bahnhof, followed by frequent valley buses to Oetz. In summer, local shuttles connect Oetz center directly with the lake.

Tipps

Rent a traditional wooden rowing boat from the southern boat dock to savor the mirror-like reflections and serene silence from the center of the lake. Enjoy fresh local trout on the lakeside terrace of the waterfront restaurant as the afternoon sun illuminates the surrounding peaks.
